title: Privacy-bounded offline session analytics
summary: Executable validation and cohort reporting for local JSONL, with explicit observation windows, traffic exclusion and source-specific denominators. No live telemetry.

sources.claim: Roblox funnels can fill earlier steps when later steps are logged; local ordered diagnostic deliberately does not.
Native event ingestion requires server-side published-game integration, not Studio fixture success.
Source-specific recommendation metrics motivate separating Home and sponsored cohorts.

limitations: No persistent player identity, return retention, unique players, revenue or rank prediction.
No actual Roblox AnalyticsService integration or platform dashboard ingestion exercised.
